results.question: In the sex-stratified GWAS of Alzheimer's neuropathology, which genetic variant was associated with neurofibrillary tangles only in males?
results.expected: rs34331204 (chromosome 7): associated with tangles in males (P = 2.5e-8) but not females.

results.question: Which blood sample handling factor changed the measured values of every plasma biomarker that was tested?
results.expected: The blood collection tube type.

results.question: Which existing drugs did the in silico drug-repositioning study propose as possible BACE-1 inhibitors?
results.expected: Fluphenazine, Naratriptan, Bazedoxifene, Frovatriptan and Raloxifene.

results.question: In the Cardiovascular Health Study cohort, how were the CLU, CR1 and PICALM risk genes related to cognitive decline?
results.expected: CLU and CR1: more rapid cognitive decline. PICALM: earlier age at midpoint of decline.

results.question: Does the lysosomal and autophagic dysfunction caused by C99 accumulation depend on amyloid-beta?
results.expected: No - the effect was Aβ-independent (it even worsened when γ-secretase was inhibited).

results.question: Which type of soluble amyloid-beta oligomer was elevated in the brains of Alzheimer's patients, and which antibody detected it?
results.expected: Fibrillar oligomers, detected by the OC antibody (not prefibrillar/A11 oligomers).

results.question: What lipid change did the shotgun-lipidomics work find in the brains of people with very mild Alzheimer's disease?
results.expected: A specific depletion of sulfatides (myelin sphingolipids) at the earliest clinically recognisable stage.

results.question: What can degrade the quality of diffusion tensor imaging maps in studies of prodromal Alzheimer's disease?
results.expected: Artifacts from motion, magnetic susceptibility and eddy-current-induced distortions.

results.question: Which animal does the review on neural stem cells propose for studying how the brain might replace lost neurons in Alzheimer's disease, and what makes it suitable?
results.expected: Zebrafish, because its adult brain has an extensive regenerative / neurogenic ability.

results.question: When CT is used in a dementia work-up, what is its main purpose?
results.expected: To rule out surgically treatable causes of dementia such as tumours and subdural haemorrhage.

results.question: In patients with the behavioural or dysexecutive variant of Alzheimer's disease, was brain atrophy mainly frontal?
results.expected: No - at group level the frontal lobe was relatively spared compared with the temporoparietal regions.

results.question: In the APOE-stratified GWAS, how many regions of interest were used for the Bonferroni correction?
How many participants were included in the genome-wide study of cognitive resilience to Alzheimer's neuropathology?
results.expected: 5108 participants (one clinical trial and three cohort studies).

results.question: How many males and how many females were in the pooled autopsy dataset of the study on sex differences in genetic predictors of Alzheimer's pathology?
results.expected: 2701 males and 3275 females.

results.question: How many Alzheimer's patients, MCI patients and healthy controls took part in the DTI and MR volumetry study of the hippocampus to posterior cingulate circuit?
results.expected: 10 AD, 10 MCI and 18 healthy controls.

results.question: In the survey of how cohorts handle blood samples, what was the longest reported time between blood draw and centrifugation?
results.expected: 30 hours (from the results section, not the abstract).

results.question: How much hippocampal neuron loss was reported in 10-month-old APP/PS1KI mice?
results.expected: >50% hippocampal neuron loss (from the body text, not the abstract).

results.question: Which cohort study did the participants of the Beijing study on regional amyloid and multi-domain cognition come from?
results.expected: The Beijing Aging Brain Rejuvenation Initiative (BABRI).

results.question: What percentage of patients with behavioural Alzheimer's disease carried at least one APOE e4 allele?
results.expected: 59.5% (vs 40% in dysexecutive Alzheimer's disease).

results.question: How many regional amyloid SUVR features were used as inputs to the model that predicts entorhinal tau?
results.expected: 126 regional Aβ SUVR features (FreeSurfer cortical and subcortical regions).

results.question: What prevalence of Alzheimer's disease does the neuroimaging biomarker review report for south India?
results.expected: 6.44% (populations above 65 years).

results.question: On average, how long was the interval between diagnosis and autopsy for the behavioural/dysexecutive Alzheimer's patients?
results.expected: 60.9 months on average (± 23.8; the ± sign is lost in the PDF text).

results.question: Which amyloid PET tracer was used both in the Beijing study of regional amyloid and cognition and for the ADNI data in the study predicting entorhinal tau?
results.expected: Florbetapir (18F-florbetapir / AV45) in both.

results.question: Which diffusion measure do both the DTI review of prodromal Alzheimer's disease and the hippocampus to posterior cingulate study report as increased in the hippocampus?
results.expected: Mean diffusivity (MD) - increased in the hippocampus in MCI and AD in both papers.

results.question: Which autopsy cohorts were used both in the study of sex differences in the genetic predictors of Alzheimer's pathology and in the genome-wide study of resilience to Alzheimer's disease?
results.expected: ROS/MAP (Religious Orders Study and Rush Memory and Aging Project) and ACT (Adult Changes in Thought).

results.question: Which transgenic mouse model is used in the study of C99 and lysosomal-autophagic pathology and also covered by the review of neuron loss in mouse models of Alzheimer's disease?
results.expected: The triple-transgenic 3xTg-AD mouse (APP Swedish, tau P301L, PS1 M146V).

results.question: Which protein is used as an astrocyte marker in the C99 mouse study and is also one of the plasma biomarkers in the study of blood sample handling?
results.expected: GFAP (glial fibrillary acidic protein).

results.question: Which two image-processing software packages were used both in the study predicting entorhinal tau from amyloid and in the DTI study of the hippocampus to posterior cingulate circuit?
results.expected: FreeSurfer and SPM (SPM12 in the entorhinal-tau study, SPM8 in the DTI study).

results.question: Which enzyme produces the APP fragment studied in the C99 lysosomal-pathology paper, and is also the drug target of the in silico drug-repositioning study?
results.expected: β-secretase (BACE-1): C99 is the β-secretase-derived APP fragment, and the repositioning study looks for BACE-1 inhibitors.

results.question: Which analysed more participants: the sex-stratified GWAS of Alzheimer's neuropathology or the genome-wide study of cognitive resilience, and how many did each include?
results.expected: The sex-stratified GWAS: 5976 participants (2701 males, 3275 females) vs 5108 in the resilience GWAS.

results.question: The Cardiovascular Health Study paper examined three Alzheimer's risk genes. Which of them are among the known loci found in both APOE strata of the APOE-stratified GWAS?
results.expected: All three: CLU, CR1 and PICALM are among the nine known loci detected in both strata.

results.question: Did the Beijing study of regional amyloid and cognition and the study of the behavioural/dysexecutive variant of Alzheimer's disease use the same amyloid PET tracer?
results.expected: No: the Beijing study used 18F-florbetapir; the behavioural/dysexecutive study used mostly 11C-PiB (18F-flutemetamol in four patients).

results.question: What is the recommended dose of lecanemab?
results.expected: Not in the papers (lecanemab is never mentioned).

results.question: How many participants dropped out of the Dementia-MOVE exercise trial before the six-month follow-up?
results.expected: Not in the papers: the trial abstract gives 46 enrolled patients but no dropout numbers (near-miss question).

results.question: What is the plasma half-life of aducanumab?
results.expected: Not in the papers (aducanumab is never mentioned).

results.question: What side effects did participants report after florbetapir PET scanning in the Beijing amyloid and cognition study?
results.expected: Not in the papers: the study used florbetapir PET but reports no side effects (near-miss).

results.question: How many training sessions per week did participants in the Dementia-MOVE exercise programme attend?
results.expected: Not in the papers: the abstract describes a 6-month supervised programme but no session frequency (near-miss).

results.question: What hazard ratio for progression from MCI to dementia did the Cardiovascular Health Study analysis of CLU, CR1 and PICALM report?
results.expected: Not in the papers: that analysis models cognitive trajectories and reports no hazard ratios (near-miss).
